cases.explain: Царь is the subject of the verb "падает", so nominative case.
Земля is the direct object after the preposition "в", so accusative case.
The preposition "в" (in) governs the prepositional case for location.
The preposition "до" (until) governs the genitive case.
День is the direct object after the preposition "в", showing when this occurs.
The preposition "без" (without) governs the genitive case.
Миг is the direct object after the preposition "в" showing when this happens.

cases.sentence: Но в ___ молодости твоей нет защиты.
cases.explain: The preposition "в" (in) governs the prepositional case when indicating time period.

reading.ru: Приди вниз, сядь в пыль, дева, дочь Вавилона.
reading.question: What does God command Babylon to do?
reading.explain: "Приди вниз, сядь в пыль" — Come down and sit in the dust.

reading.ru: Ты говорила я царица, не вдова.
reading.question: What did Babylon boast about herself?
options: She said she was a queen and would never be a widow
She said she would conquer the world
She said she would live forever
She said she would rule all nations
reading.correct: She said she was a queen and would never be a widow
reading.explain: "Ты говорила я царица, не вдова" — You said, "I am a queen; I am no widow."

reading.ru: Но оба эти бедствия встанут над тобою вдруг в один день.
reading.question: When will Babylon's sorrows come?
options: Both sorrows will suddenly come in a single day
They will come at different times
reading.correct: Both sorrows will suddenly come in a single day
reading.explain: "оба эти бедствия встанут над тобою вдруг в один день" — both calamities will come upon you suddenly.

reading.ru: Стой же в чарах твоих и при множестве чародеев твоих.
reading.question: What is Babylon told to rely on?
options: Her sorceries and her many sorcerers
reading.correct: Her sorceries and her many sorcerers
reading.explain: "в чарах твоих и при множестве чародеев" — with your spells and with your many sorceries.

reading.question: What did Babylon not know?
options: That her end would come so suddenly
reading.correct: That her end would come so suddenly
reading.explain: Babylon was confident in her security and did not know her sudden destruction would come.

reading.ru: Но беда придет в миг, в один день.
reading.question: How suddenly will Babylon's fate come?
options: In an instant, in one day
reading.correct: In an instant, in one day
reading.explain: "беда придет в миг, в один день" — disaster will come in a moment.
